```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(DESeq2)
library(ggplot2)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(enrichplot)
library(RCy3)
library(simplifyEnrichment)
library(pheatmap)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)

```

## Set up the settings for analysis

```{r cars}
ref_group  <- "QE"        # reference level for the design
alpha      <- 0.05         # adjusted p-value cutoff for DEGs
lfc_cutoff <- 1            # |log2FC| cutoff for DEGs

contrasts <- list(         # c("group", numerator, denominator)
  QE_vs_QL1  = c("group", "QE", "QL1"),
  QE_vs_QL2  = c("group", "QE", "QL2"),
  QE_vs_W = c("group", "QE", "W"),
  W_vs_QL1 = c("group", "W", "QL1"),
  W_vs_QL2 = c("group", "W", "QL2"),
  QL1_vs_QL2 = c("group", "QL1", "QL2")
)

species   <- "Apis mellifera"
key_type  <- "SYMBOL"
kegg_code <- "ame"
custom_files <- c( GO = file.path(getwd(),"enrichment_terms","gene2go.tsv"),
  KEGG = file.path(getwd(),"enrichment_terms","gene2kegg.tsv"))


enrich_p  <- 0.05   # adjusted p-value cutoff for enriched terms
min_genes <- 5 

counts <- read.csv(file.path(getwd(),"gene_counts_matrix.csv"), row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
counts <- as.matrix(counts)
mode(counts) <- "integer"
```

## Create Deseq2 object and run Deseq2
```{r}
dir.create("DEG_results")
coldata <- data.frame(
  row.names = colnames(counts),
  group     = factor(sub("_.*", "", colnames(counts))),
  sample_names = colnames(counts)
)
coldata$group <- relevel(coldata$group, ref = ref_group)
print(coldata)

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts, colData = coldata,
                              design = ~ group)
dds <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds) >= 10) >= 3, ]
dds <- DESeq(dds)
print(resultsNames(dds))

results_list <- lapply(names(contrasts), function(nm) {
  res    <- results(dds, contrast = contrasts[[nm]], alpha = alpha)
  res_df <- as.data.frame(res)
  res_df$gene <- rownames(res_df)
  res_df <- res_df[order(res_df$padj), ]
  write.csv(res_df, paste0("DEG_results/DESeq2_", nm, ".csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  message(nm, ": ",
          sum(res$padj < alpha & abs(res$log2FoldChange) >= lfc_cutoff, na.rm = TRUE),
          " DEGs (padj < ", alpha, ", |log2FC| >= ", lfc_cutoff, ")")
  res_df
})
names(results_list) <- names(contrasts)

```

## Create Volcano plots
Create volcano plots as a visualization of the Differential gene expression analysis

```{r}
dir.create("DEG_results")
vsd <- vst(dds, blind = TRUE)
pdf("DEG_results/QC_plots.pdf", width = 7, height = 6)
print(plotPCA(vsd, intgroup = "group") + theme_bw() + ggtitle("PCA (VST counts)"))
plotDispEsts(dds)
dev.off()

volcano <- function(df, title) {
  df$status <- "NS"
  df$status[df$padj < alpha & df$log2FoldChange >=  lfc_cutoff] <- "Up"
  df$status[df$padj < alpha & df$log2FoldChange <= -lfc_cutoff] <- "Down"
  ggplot(df, aes(log2FoldChange, -log10(padj), colour = status)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(Down = "blue", NS = "grey70", Up = "red")) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-lfc_cutoff, lfc_cutoff), linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(alpha), linetype = "dashed") +
    theme_bw() + ggtitle(title)
}
pdf("DEG_results/Volcano_plots.pdf", width = 7, height = 6)
for (nm in names(results_list)) print(volcano(results_list[[nm]], nm))
dev.off()

```

## Prepare annotation information for functional gene enrichment
We need to load the previously created annotation information for the the functional gene enrichment 
```{r}
dir.create("enrichment", showWarnings = FALSE)

library(GO.db)
custom_sets <- lapply(names(custom_files), function(lbl) {
  raw <- read.delim(custom_files[[lbl]], header = FALSE, quote = "",
                    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)       # gene, term [, term name]
  t2g <- unique(data.frame(term = raw[[2]], gene = raw[[1]],
                           stringsAsFactors = FALSE))  # enricher wants term, gene
  t2n <- NULL
  if (ncol(raw) >= 3)
    t2n <- unique(data.frame(term = raw[[2]], name = raw[[3]],
                             stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  if (toupper(lbl) == "GO") {
    nm <- AnnotationDbi::select(GO.db, keys = unique(t2g$term),
                                columns = c("TERM", "ONTOLOGY"), keytype = "GOID")
    t2n <- nm[, c("GOID", "TERM")]
    # keep the three ontologies separate
    sets <- lapply(c(BP = "BP", MF = "MF", CC = "CC"), function(ont) {
      ids <- nm$GOID[nm$ONTOLOGY == ont]
      list(t2g = t2g[t2g$term %in% ids, ], t2n = t2n)
    })
    return(setNames(sets, paste0("GO_", names(sets))))
  }
  setNames(list(list(t2g = t2g, t2n = t2n)), lbl)
})
custom_sets <- unlist(custom_sets, recursive = FALSE)
# unlist() prefixes names (e.g. "GO.GO_BP") -> tidy up
names(custom_sets) <- sub("^[^.]+\\.", "", names(custom_sets))
```

## Enrichment function
Because we need to run the enrichment analysis once for every contrast between bee groups we create a function to handle the enrichment
``` {r}
run_enrichment <- function(genes, universe) {
  out <- list()
  for (lbl in names(custom_sets)) {
    s <- custom_sets[[lbl]]
    out[[lbl]] <- tryCatch(
      enricher(gene = genes, universe = universe, TERM2GENE = s$t2g,
               TERM2NAME = s$t2n, pAdjustMethod = "BH",
               pvalueCutoff = enrich_p, qvalueCutoff = 0.2),
      error = function(e) { message("  ", lbl, " failed: ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL })
  }
  
  out
}
```


## run the enrichment for every contrast
we run seperate enrichment analysis for the up regulated genes down regulated genes and all differentially expressed genes to see what functions are linked with what group of genes
```{r}
all_enrich <- list()

for (nm in names(results_list)) {
  df       <- results_list[[nm]]
  tested   <- !is.na(df$padj)
  universe <- df$gene[tested]                       # background = all tested genes
  deg_sets <- list(
    up   = df$gene[tested & df$padj < alpha & df$log2FoldChange >=  lfc_cutoff],
    down = df$gene[tested & df$padj < alpha & df$log2FoldChange <= -lfc_cutoff],
    all  = df$gene[tested & df$padj < alpha & abs(df$log2FoldChange) >= lfc_cutoff]
  )
  
  for (dir_nm in names(deg_sets)) {
    genes <- deg_sets[[dir_nm]]
    tag   <- paste(nm, dir_nm, sep = "_")
    message("\n== ", tag, ": ", length(genes), " genes ==")
    if (length(genes) < min_genes) { message("  too few genes, skipped"); next }
    
    res_enr <- run_enrichment(genes, universe)
    all_enrich[[tag]] <- res_enr
    
    pdf(file.path("enrichment", paste0("plots_", tag, ".pdf")), width = 9, height = 7)
    for (db in names(res_enr)) {
      obj <- res_enr[[db]]
      if (is.null(obj) || nrow(as.data.frame(obj)) == 0) next
      write.csv(as.data.frame(obj),
                file.path("enrichment", paste0(tag, "_", db, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
      n_sig <- sum(as.data.frame(obj)$p.adjust < enrich_p)
      message("  ", db, ": ", n_sig, " significant terms")
      if (n_sig > 0) {
        print(dotplot(obj, showCategory = 20, title = paste(tag, db)) + theme_bw())
        print(barplot(obj, showCategory = 20, title = paste(tag, db)))
      }
    }
    dev.off()
  }
}
```

## ASCA
```{r}
group  <- factor(sub("_.*", "", colnames(DEG_counts)))
counts <- DEG_counts[rowSums(DEG_counts >= 10) >= 3, ]
X      <- t(vst(counts, blind = TRUE))          # samples x genes (matrix)


dat   <- data.frame(group = group, row.names = rownames(X))
dat$Y <- X


mod <- asca(Y ~ group, data = dat)              
print(mod)
summary(mod)                                    # variance explained per effect


sc   <- scores(mod,      factor = 1)            # one row per group level (in level order)
ld   <- loadings(mod,    factor = 1)            # genes x components
proj <- proj <- scale(X, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE) %*% ld           # individual samples 


cols <- seq_along(levels(group)) + 1           
pdf("DEG_results/DEG_ASCA_multiblock_plots.pdf", width = 7, height = 6)
plot(proj[, 1], proj[, 2], col = cols[group], pch = 19, cex = 1.3,
     xlab = "Component 1", ylab = "Component 2", main = "ASCA group effect")
points(sc[, 1], sc[, 2], col = cols, pch = 4, cex = 2.5, lwd = 3)   # group scores
legend("topright", legend = c(levels(group), "Group score"),
       col = c(cols, "black"), pch = c(rep(19, length(cols)), 4), bty = "n")
loadingplot(mod, factor = 1)                    # genes, so no group legend needed
dev.off()

#representation in R
plot(proj[, 1], proj[, 2], col = cols[group], pch = 19, cex = 1.3,
     xlab = "Component 1", ylab = "Component 2", main = "ASCA group effect")
points(sc[, 1], sc[, 2], col = cols, pch = 4, cex = 2.5, lwd = 3)   # group scores
legend("topright", legend = c(levels(group), "Group score"),
       col = c(cols, "black"), pch = c(rep(19, length(cols)), 4), bty = "n")


```
